exception_message: CUDA out of memory allocating a 1.22 GiB float32 cross-entropy workspace after the full-row forward succeeded.
root_cause: Serial row execution made the exact native write/read graph fit, but full-vocabulary float32 CE over a long assistant target still materialized a target-length workspace at once.
resolution: Compute the identical summed float32 CE in activation-checkpointed 64-token chunks so only one bounded vocabulary workspace is live while autograd still produces the same global token-normalized gradient.
restart_policy: Discard the partial optimizer state and retry from the exact R12 warm start.
